reviews.title: So easy to install and roomy too
reviews.body: I was really happy with the quality of the shelves - they aren't flimsy, they are just deep enough to fit 2 small/medium-sized aerosol cans front to back, the front lip is the perfect height for not letting items fall forward but not making it something you have to reach over, and they were really easy to install. I put up 3 shelves (in a vertical row), just above the bathroom vanity and now there's no more clutter on the counter! Each shelf had one screw in a stud and I used a small drywall anchor for the other screw, just to be sure they would stand up over time.  For this price I was pretty blown away with what I got!

reviews.title: Clean look, easy to install
reviews.body: Went up in under 20 minutes with a drill and level. The finish looks better than expected for the price and easy to clean. I used some of the included anchors, depending on the wall (one drywall, one siding)  and had zero sag with small plant, candles and vases. Sits flush against the wall, stable and not very wide, which gives off a nice sleek appearance. You will see the hardware, noting that mine did not come with screw covers or stickers, so I can see the screws. As far as the shelf itself, it will hold a 4.25 width book (for reference), but nothing wider than than 4 3/8. Great value, seeing as you’re getting 6 shelves.

reviews.title: Great small shelves - and all the same size!
reviews.body: One thing I noticed when looking for small floating shelves is most vendors would sell different sizes. Length would have been ok, but they were also all different widths. I imagine you would want all the same size.I got two packs of six for my need. Ended up with a 3x3 design.The shelves are nice and light, look great, and came very well packed. Included hardware for both concrete or drywall. In my config, these went on drywall had an AC duct behind. I cut a screw and anchor in half and worked out great.One thing to keep in mind. Go VERY SLOW and use a Philips screwdriver and not a power tool with the anchors or they will break. Both packages included one extra set of anchors and screws which is appreciated.
